issues.reason: The to-PP half stands — 'to Kodak's revenue' is the goal of the adding, and `Patient` is a direct-object role reserved for what the action changes, so the atom records the revenue as the thing added, which is false — while the missing-direct-object half is refuted: a bare measure-phrase object is gap territory and `(Measure <event> quantity ...)` records the amount truthfully in a licensed shape (measures on events are licensed, cf. `duration`).

`Degree`'s first argument is the property BEARER — `(Degree alice tall very)`, `(Degree sk_soup_1 hot excessive)` — so anchoring it on the reified state witness says the dilutive-state is itself slightly dilutive.

Calibration line: this is the reviewer's own registered gap (a proper-noun participant modifier of a deverbal head noun), and `(Of sk_acquisition_1 practiceworks)` is true of the sentence, well-typed, and uses the already-licensed entity-attached oblique head rather than a coined one — graceful improvisation in gap territory.

Also gap territory the reviewer registers (an ordinal-described relative span); a bare snake_case time constant is the shape already licensed for multi-word temporal constants (`this_morning`, `last_week`), it asserts nothing false and coins no relation head, and `first_full_year` is a time constant, not a class needing decomposition.

gaps_confirmed: a proper-noun modifier naming a PARTICIPANT of a deverbal head noun ('the PracticeWorks acquisition'): the compound rules exclude proper nouns, the name+kind pattern is for a name that IS the thing, and no surface preposition exists to hang an oblique on

an ordinal-described relative time span ('in the first full year'): `Time` fillers are calendar granularities, deictics or named times, none of which covers a span picked out by rank relative to an unstated anchor

a relative-polarity predicate contrasted across two spans ('dilutive through 2005, accretive thereafter'): dual-emit forces both flat copular atoms out, and inside one seal they read as simultaneously true
new_gaps: a bare measure-phrase direct object ('add about $215 million'): there is no NP witness to fill `Theme` / `Patient`, and no stated route for putting the amount itself into a role slot
'thereafter' — an anaphoric temporal adverb pointing past a preceding interval's end has no listed carrier; the parse improvises with `(Before <state1> <state2>)`
repair_summary: Re-slotted the goal PP: (Patient sk_add_1 sk_revenue_1) becomes (Goal sk_add_1 sk_revenue_1). Moved the degree onto its bearer: (Degree sk_dilutive_1 dilutive slightly) becomes (Degree sk_acquisition_1 dilutive slightly). No other atom, symbol or ordering changed.
notes: The impersonal-reported-attitude routing (expect reified with no `Experiencer`, content sealed under `Theme`, definite referents projected, no tense inside the non-finite complement) and the 10%-sigma tight-hedge `ParticleFromNormal` are correct as they stand.
